title: Administrator
company: Encon Staffing Associates Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Encon Staffing is recruiting a Compliance Administrator for a supported housing organisation in Bradford. The organisation provides accommodation alongside care, support or supervision, helping people live as independently as possible.

You ll join a busy Compliance and Property Team, giving admin support to the Compliance Manager and Property Coordinator. Your work will help make sure every property used for residents meets statutory compliance and health and safety requirements.

What you ll be doing
- Logging repairs reported by support staff and residents, raising work orders and following them through to completion
- Liaising with repairs and compliance contractors, and chasing compliance documents, completed work orders, overdue jobs and invoices
- Checking and verifying documents before approving them or escalating them where needed
- Asking contractors for updated compliance certificates before they expire, and urgently following up any that have lapsed
- Keeping records accurate and up to date on internal systems, including CAFM and databases
- Supporting the onboarding and offboarding of properties so they stay compliant with H&S legislation and government guidance
- Managing key coordination across the property portfolio and acting as the central point of contact for keys
- Following access processes, including issuing, recording and keeping appointment letters
- Creating contracts, SLAs and other required documents for service users and providers
- Spotting non-compliance and giving providers support and guidance to resolve it
- Producing accurate management information and performance reports on time
- Handling enquiries from the local council, residents, staff and providers in person, by phone and by email
- Supporting the scheduling of inspectors calendars
- Working with the Quality Assurance, Benefits and Contract Performance teams as needed
- Reviewing contractor compliance and acting where standards or contract terms aren t being met
- Taking appropriate action on building notices, planning applications and housing standards referrals

What we re looking for
- Previous experience in an admin role, ideally in compliance, property, housing or facilities management
- Confidence using IT systems such as Excel, Word, CAFM systems and databases
- Strong organisational skills and a flexible approach to work
- Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to chase contractors and handle queries professionally
- High attention to detail and accuracy when checking documents and records
- A proactive problem-solver who understands how issues affect the wider operation
- Ability to work to targets and SLAs as part of a high-performing team
- Knowledge of property compliance or H&S legislation (desirable)

Why apply?
- Rewarding work in an organisation that supports people to live independently
- Stable office-based hours with no weekends
- A collaborative team focused on continuous improvement
- Opportunities for training and professional development

Professional, proactive and client-focused approach.

description:

title: Internal Sales / New Business Executive
description:
Internal Sales / New Business Executive

Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire

Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 basic + Bonus + Benefits

Streamline Search is working with an established and highly regarded large-format print and visual communications business that is looking to appoint an ambitious Internal Sales / New Business Executive.

Our client has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality print and visual communication solutions to a broad range of commercial customers across the UK.

The business offers an end-to-end service, supporting customers from initial concept and technical consultation through to production, finishing and installation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys prospecting, opening doors and developing new customer relationships.

The role will initially be predominantly office-based, focused on generating and qualifying new business opportunities through proactive outbound activity.

There is genuine scope for the successful candidate to develop into a more senior Business Development position over time, taking greater ownership of customer meetings, account development and the full sales cycle.

Package
- 30,000 - 35,000 basic salary
- Uncapped / performance-related bonus structure
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday office-based role
- Opportunity to join an established and respected business
- Excellent product and production capabilities
- Strong market reputation
- Genuine progression into a Business Development role
- Support from experienced senior commercial staff on meetings and larger opportunities

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities through proactive outbound sales activity.

This is a genuine new-business role and would suit someone who enjoys picking up the phone, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying opportunities and building a strong pipeline.

Initially, the focus will be on prospecting, lead generation and developing relationships from first contact. For larger opportunities, you will work closely with senior commercial colleagues who can support with client meetings, technical discussions, proposals and closing.

As you develop your knowledge and customer base, there will be scope to take greater ownership of the complete sales cycle and progress into a Business Development Manager position.

Key Responsibilities
- Making proactive outbound calls to prospective customers
- Identifying and targeting businesses with potential large-format print and visual communication requirements
- Building relationships with key decision-makers
- Generating and qualifying new business opportunities
- Developing opportunities through telephone, email and LinkedIn outreach
- Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective customers
- Booking customer meetings for yourself and senior commercial colleagues
- Following up quotations, proposals and live opportunities
- Working closely with senior management to progress and close larger opportunities
- Approaching marketing teams, agencies, retailers, contractors, event businesses and other relevant organisations
- Understanding customer requirements and introducing suitable solutions
- Keeping CRM and pipeline information accurate and up to date
- Re-engaging previous customers and dormant accounts
- Identifying opportunities across new sectors and markets
- Converting prospects into profitable, long-term customers
- Achieving agreed activity, new-business and revenue targets

The Candidate

We are looking for an ambitious, confident and commercially driven sales professional who genuinely enjoys new-business development.

You do not necessarily need to have worked within large-format print previously, although experience within print, manufacturing, signage, packaging, marketing services or another B2 B environment would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous B2 B sales, internal sales, telesales or business development experience
- A genuine appetite for winning new business
- Confidence making outbound calls and approaching new organisations
- Strong communication skills and a natural ability to build rapport
- A proactive and resilient approach to sales
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to discuss customer requirements
- Strong follow-up and organisational skills
- A target-driven mindset
- The ability to work independently while also taking guidance from senior colleagues
- A desire to develop into a more senior Business Development position

This role could suit an experienced Internal Sales Executive, New Business Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an ambitious Account Manager looking to move into a more proactive new-business position.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - UK and Europe

Location: Bradford, UK - Must live within a commutable distance to Bradford

Hours: Full Time

Reports to: Marketing Manager - US Corporate Office

Are you ready to take your marketing career to an international level?

Join our company, a successful US-headquartered manufacturer with a strong family-owned culture, ambitious growth plans and a genuine commitment to its people.

In this varied role, you will be part of our global Corporate Marketing team, supporting company-wide initiatives while also helping to shape marketing activity for the UK and Europe from our Bradford site.

You will have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, take ownership of projects and make a visible contribution within a collaborative, values-led business where creativity, autonomy and global thinking are encouraged.

Role overview

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator with a broad set of skills, a proactive approach and the ambition to develop with the business.

The role will involve conducting market research, analysing data, supporting business development activity and regional events, and creating localised promotional materials that clearly communicate how our products, manufacturing expertise, service, lead times and high-quality materials meet the needs of customers across the UK and Europe.

This role would suit someone who is comfortable working independently, taking ownership of tasks, and bringing creative, practical ideas to the team.

You will be organised, curious and self-motivated, with the confidence to work autonomously while staying well connected to colleagues across the wider global marketing function.

Responsibilities include:
- Conduct market research and qualify results to determine potential customers and competitors.
- Help develop and integrate our regional marketing presence in the EU and UK, as well as support broader business development and customer outreach efforts.
- Maintain and optimise customer relationship management database to segment customers for targeted promotional communications.
- Manage social media pages and ensure messaging is aligned with company guidelines.
- Create and deliver integrated campaigns for qualified prospects and existing customers.
- Develop marketing materials for specific market segments (e-mailers, technical bulletins, presentations, and handbooks) and related internal training documents to support best practices.
- Capture, create, and communicate market performance data (sales trends, account status, and website analytic reports) to sales team on a consistent basis.
- Coordinate logistics and sales support for trade shows, develop targeted marketing collateral, and research markets or additional event-specific promotional opportunities.
- Embrace TGC's strong culture of continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience

You will ideally bring:
- Degree-level education in marketing, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Previous experience in a marketing role, with exposure to campaign support, content creation, research, data analysis and internal or external communications.
- Strong written communication, organisation, research and data-management skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
- A good understanding of core marketing principles, audience segmentation, customer communications and the importance of consistent brand messaging.
- Clear written and spoken English.
- A self-motivated and organised approach, with the confidence to work autonomously, take ownership, collaborate with international colleagues and bring creative ideas forward.

It would also be beneficial if you have:
- An additional qualification in marketing, digital marketing, communications or design.
- Experience working within an international business and/or manufacturing environment across UK and European markets.
- Experience with HTML, CRM systems, Adobe Acrobat or other design, email marketing or digital content tools.
- Awareness of local business culture, European markets and basic technical or manufacturing terminology.
- Second-language skills, particularly German.
- A curious, proactive and adaptable approach, with an interest in continuous improvement and developing marketing activity in a growing international business.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful international business where you can develop your marketing experience across the UK and European markets while being part of a wider global Corporate Marketing team.

Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career with us

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Service Coordinator
£14.46 - £16.37 per hour 37 hours per week 6-month fixed-term contract Hybrid/flexible working

We're recruiting for a Service Coordinator to join a not-for-profit organisation based in Bradford, supporting its Children and Young People (CYP) services.
This is a 6-month fixed-term role, with the possibility of extending depending on service requirements. You'll provide important operational and administrative support during a period of workforce transition, vacancies and staff absence, helping to keep things running smoothly across the service.

What will you be doing?
As a Service Coordinator, you'll support a range of operational processes, including:
- Completing case file audits, file closure reviews and service activity spot checks.
- Maintaining audit records and following up on outstanding actions.
- Supporting accurate record keeping and compliance with service procedures.
- Monitoring incidents and safeguarding concerns, ensuring actions are followed up and recorded appropriately.
- Maintaining incident and safeguarding trackers and escalating overdue actions where needed.
- Monitoring referrals, caseloads and waiting lists across CYP services.
- Keeping databases, records and trackers accurate and up to date.
- Supporting data quality checks and producing routine operational reports.
- Coordinating staff rotas, cover arrangements and workforce records.

What are we looking for?
You'll need previous experience in an administrative, coordination or operational support role, along with:
- Maintaining databases, trackers and records.
- Producing reports and monitoring information.
- Spporting quality assurance or audit processes.
- Knowledge of safeguarding within children's, health, social care or voluntary sector settings.
- Strong organisational and IT skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Confidence using databases, spreadsheets and reporting systems.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively across different teams.

You'll be organised, reliable and comfortable keeping on top of several priorities at once. This is a role where accuracy, follow-through and good communication are important.
What's on offer?
- Flexible/hybrid working in line with service requirements.
- 6-month fixed-term contract, with potential to extend.
- 25 days' annual leave, increasing to 28 days with length of service, plus bank holidays (pro rata).
- Up to two additional wellbeing days each year.
- Simply Health Cash Plan, including support towards dental, optical, prescriptions and physiotherapy costs.
- Employee Assistance Service with 24/7 confidential mental health support and access to structured therapy sessions.
- Generous pension scheme and employer contribution.
- Discount schemes including Company Shop and Blue Light Card.
- Personal development opportunities, including access to Clinical Supervision.
- Enhanced sick pay after six-month probation.
- Accredited employer with Mindful Employer, Disability Confident and Real Living Wage.

title: MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST
description: We need a reliable, motivated, hard working and flexible individual to join our friendly busy team. Must have SystmOne experience withgood computer and communication skills. To work 25.5 hours per week To commence as soon as possible. FLEXIBILITY IS ESSENTIAL TO THIS ROLE. Greeting and directing patients and visitors on arrival. Signposting patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional. Registering new patients. Booking appointments. Using photocopier, telephone, email and clinical system. Respond to the needs of clinicians during surgery. Respond to requests from Management. Preparing consultation rooms, prior to and after surgery. General housekeeping (e.g. keeping waiting and office areas clean and tidy). Action tasks on SystmOne Provide clerical assistance to support the delivery of patient services, e.g. post, data input and scanning. Specified Duties To provide and effective, polite and efficient point of contact to all patients and visitors to the Practice. To create and instil an atmosphere of calm, pleasant and peaceful surrounds. Maintain a positive attitude at all times. Smile when you answer the phone. Remember never say it is not my job to. Always say what you can do, not what you cannot do. Acknowledge and welcome the arrival of patients with a booked appointment at the front desk. Make future appointments and allocate appropriate same day appointments. Liaise with duty doctor via SystmOne any instructions regarding the processing of lists that are undertaken in line with the agreed procedure. Answer the telephone within 4 rings and ensure all messages are recorded in SystmOne and are dealt with or passed to the appropriate person for action. Deal with actions arising from the post when dealt with by the duty doctor. Deal with prescriptions requests and home visit requests as they come in, on the telephone and face to face. Make up a visit list each day and print out a patient summary relating to each person being visited. Exhibit willingness to train on new technology and updated systems, as required. Ensure all aspects of Health and safety are adhered to and breaches reported to Management. Flexibility when asked to cover shifts for holidays, sickness, absences remember you never know when you might need cover. Generally keeping the reception area, in fact all areas clean and tidy. Scan all post into SystmOne record as agreed. Ensure accurate data entry onto SystmOne according to protocols. Liaise with other Health Care professionals, as and when necessary to ensure relevant people are advised of developments, which affect patients under their care. To work in a manner that ensures the smooth running of the Practice. Receiving and receipting monies. Using email facilities as an internal communication tool. At the end of the day ensure all areas of reception are tidy in order to ensure easy accessibility for the cleaners. To ensure all areas are secure at night, all electrical equipment is switched off and that the building is secure when last to leave. Ensure phone lines are switched over to the preferred out of hours provider. Complete all tasks relevant to position. Complete and maintain targets as set out and agreed by the Practice Manager in annual appraisal. Read and adhere to all protocols. Work as a team Filing with accuracy Use alert/reminder templates Prescriptions pull out non-collected ones after 3 months Change patient names and addresses Stocking up clinical rooms Maintain security of the premises Maintain ultimate confidentiality This job description is not exhaustive and therefore other duties may be asked of you by the clinic/management team if within your physical and educational capabilities.

title: Receptionist
location: Shipley, BD18 3EG, Shipley, BD18 3EE, Bradford, BD10 9AZ
description: As a key member of the Patient Services team you will be responsible for providing an efficient reception function that includes some specific administration duties. To ensure the front of house service of meeting and greeting is welcoming and portrays our standards of high quality, professional and patient-focused care. To ensure a high focus on customer satisfaction by dealing with queries in a speedy and accurate manner, applying emotionally conscious responses as relevant. To deal with patients and visitors in a courteous manner, using your skills to ensure matters are dealt with efficiently; providing effective management to patient demand, and reducing undue delay or queues at the front desk/phones To work to protocols with regard booking appointments, repeat prescriptions, ordering of patient transport including emergency ambulances and all other duties as explained to you by the Patient Services Manager. To deal with general queries and liaise effectively with clinicians and other staff as required. To support clinicians during their clinics by dealing with their queries and tasks as requested. This may be the need for some stock in their rooms, following up an appointment with the hospital, or other ad hoc requests. To provide chaperoning service where requested by the clinician and/or patient. To ensure patient confidentiality, including the use of the computer system and visibility of the screen as well as the transfer of written and verbal communication. To converse with patients and visitors by speaking clearly, precisely and with confidence both over the phone and face-to-face at the desk. To signpost patients to the most appropriate service.
